[#](53341a)A poppet in a pocket is useful. A poppet on a shelf that activates itself when needed is more useful still.[#]()

[#](53341a)The Poppet Shelf holds up to nine.[#]()
pages.title: The Poppet Shelf

pages.text: [#](53341a)When you take damage or are killed, it scans nearby shelves for poppets bound to you and triggers the right protection. You need not be watching — that is the point.[#]()
[#](53341a)Build it, fill it, and stop thinking about it. It will think for itself when the time comes.[#]()
